body:
While the app stays open, what agents do must keep appearing without a restart or reload. Today it doesn't: "Agent working", "Needs attention" and toasts have stopped appearing, and a new question from an agent does not show on its task.

**Known case:** on task:4ecf4f5061289cbf, run 70432a3336db22f6 asked a second question. The server recorded it and the run is `waiting`, but the human cannot see it on the open app. The human has not tried a restart, so whether one clears it is unknown.

**Cause: not established.** Find it by reproducing the failure; the following is a cursory lead, not a prescription. All these signals come from the `/events` stream. `events` in `solace-cli/board/src/api.mjs` has an empty `onerror`, and a browser's EventSource closes for good on a non-200 reply. In `board::server.serve`, a `board.route` error on `/events` gets such a reply. The Strategy page and the task element have their own `events` bindings, not yet read. Also check whether the question is missing only live, or also when the task is opened afresh.

**Done when**, with a page left open:
- a new question appears on its task, and a toast is raised for it
- "Agent working" appears when a run starts and goes when it ends
- "Needs attention" appears when a task needs the human
- all of the above still hold after the connection to the server is dropped or refused, and after the server restarts

**Tests:** cover the failure found, at the level where it occurs.

This task adds no new user-interface elements.
title: Fix: pages stop showing live updates
